visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium close-up of a woman wearing a blue baseball cap and a white hoodie, standing outdoors with blurred cherry blossoms in the background. She smiles and gestures with her hands while speaking. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor setting where the woman, now without a cap and with her hair pinned back, is shown in a medium shot. She is wearing a blue and white striped camisole. She demonstrates a skincare routine, first spraying a mist on her face and then applying a cream. (3) A product bottle of La Roche-Posay Anthelios Uvidea Tone-Up Rosy is held up close to the camera. The woman then squeezes the pinkish cream onto her hand and applies it to one side of her face. (4) Split-screen or comparison shots appear with labels "Before" and "After," highlighting the brightening effect on her skin. She continues to apply makeup, including using a cushion foundation over the base. (5) She is then seen indoors wearing a white turtleneck and a silver necklace, holding a black digital skin-testing device to her cheek. The device displays "100%" initially and then "81%" in a subsequent shot to show longevity. (6) The video concludes with the woman back outdoors among the cherry blossoms, wearing her blue cap and white hoodie again, posing and smiling for the camera.

(10) [Subtitle]: 這陣子我都用理膚寶水新升級的新瑰蜜霜 它是玫瑰粉色乳液質地 非常好推開. [Logo]: 新瑰蜜霜. (11) [Subtitle]: 它裡面有保濕成分可以讓底妝更貼 那你可以用手抹開就好. (12) [Subtitle]: 記得是單方向抹開不要來回來回搓 它會比較好成膜. (13) [Variety]: Before. After. (4) Narrative voice explains product benefits like 'tone-up' and 'longevity' with digital UI 'ding' sound effects for emphasis. (5) Final segment returns to the outdoor environment with faint wind sounds mixed with the voice and BGM, ending on a positive note.
